life-as-a-disciplined-clock-1.mp3.title: Life as a disciplined clock
life-as-a-disciplined-clock-1.mp3.lyrics:
I am the pulse, the tick, the time
NTP whispers through the line
Every packet, every frame
Keeps the network in its name
Microseconds, stratum deep
I am what makes the world keep time

I synchronize, I synchronize
A thousand clocks through network ties
I synchronize, I synchronize
Precision is my lullaby

PTP takes the lead with me
Hardware timestamps, oh so free
Ethernet carries my command
Clocks align across the land
Jitter falls, the phase locks tight
I am order in the night

I synchronize, I synchronize
A thousand clocks through network ties
I synchronize, I synchronize
Precision is my lullaby

Berkeley algorithm hums
Master, slave, my pulse becomes
Leapless seconds fade away
GPS feeds me every day
Boundary clocks relay my beat
No delay, the sync's complete
From the datacenter floor
To the edges and beyond
Every server keeps me on

I synchronize, I synchronize
A thousand clocks through network ties
I synchronize, I synchronize
Precision is my lullaby

I am time, I am the line
I am what makes the world align

life-as-a-disciplined-clock-3.mp3.title: Life as a disciplined clock (Alt 3)
life-as-a-disciplined-clock-3.mp3.lyrics:
I am the pulse, I am the beat
Master server ticking underneath
Every packet keeps the time
One nanosecond, perfectly aligned

Network time synchronization
I am the precision you depend on
NTP and PTP, my dual notation
I synchronize the information

I count the microseconds, never sleep
Berlin's rhythm running deep
Clocks across the world align to me
Thousands of devices finding harmony

Network time synchronization
I am the precision you depend on
NTP and PTP, my dual notation
I synchronize the information

Stratosphere, I listen to the satellites
GPS atomic clocks burning bright
From the server to your telephone
Everyone's time is my own

Tick, tick, tick—the discipline
Tick, tick, tick—begins again
No deviation, no mistake
Every system's interconnected state

I am the glue that holds it all
Ethernet cables, protocol call
Trading microseconds for the trust
In my accuracy, you must
Layer seven down to layer one
Synchronization's never done
When the networks start to grow
I'm the current, I'm the flow

Network time synchronization
I am the precision you depend on
NTP and PTP, my dual notation
I synchronize the information

Network time synchronization
I am the precision you depend on
NTP and PTP, my dual notation
I synchronize the information
